title: Backup
description: Save a full copy of all your data, so nothing is lost if something goes wrong.
whatBody: A backup has everything: employees, raw materials, production, brick stock, customers, sales and payments.
lastBackupHint: Take a backup at least once a week.
passwordHint: At least 16 letters. A short sentence works well.
keepSafe: Keep this password safe — without it the backup cannot be opened.

download.title: Download backup
download.description: Saves the backup on this phone or computer. Copy it to a pen drive or Google Drive.
download.unencryptedWarning: Not recommended. Anyone who gets this file can read all your customers, sales and staff details.
download.currentPasswordHint: Needed to download a file anyone can read.

email.title: Email backup
email.description: Sends the backup to an email address. Tell the password by phone — never in the same email.
email.tooLarge: The backup is too big to email. Please download it instead.

automatic.title: Automatic daily backup
automatic.onBody: A backup is made every day without anyone doing anything.
automatic.offBody: Not switched on yet. Ask the person who set up the server to switch it on.

helpBody: Give the backup file and its password to the person who set up the server. They can put everything back.

validation.passphrasesDoNotMatch: The two passwords are not the same.
validation.wrongPassword: That is not your login password.
